notes.title: Newest Bugfixes and Update
notes.notes:
[h1]⭐ Our latest update! ⭐[/h1]

[b]Dear Super Dungeon Maker community! [/b]

this update took way longer than anticipated, but finally we we're able to release it for all of you!

[h2]⭐ What's new?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a [b]Recommended Dungeons[/b] tab to the online dungeon browser where the Dev team will add a few of their favorite player created dungeons in the future.
[*] Map now automatically focuses on player position when opening it.
[*] Added save popup when exiting the dungeon after collecting the golden egg in the editor.
[/list]

[h2]🔥 What's been fixed?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Player is now correctly shown on the map when playing a dungeon.
[*] Added Tooltips for some objects that were missing.
[*] Online Dungeons would sometimes play the wrong music.
[*] Stairs were missing in some dungeons.
[/list]

[h3]👍 What are "Recommended Dungeons"?[/h3]

The SDM team might just stumble across a fun dungeon by themselves or via the share your dungeon thread on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rokaplay]Discord[/url]. Just always try to create the most fun dungeons and it may very well be one of the newest additions to the list! The list is a wild collection of fun, long, short, puzzles, adventures and generally everything great about SDM! [b]Go check them out if you want to spend a good time![/b]

Also if you need friends to share your dungeons with, or just want to hang out with a great creative community, definitely check out our Discord server! We've got several ways to share your dungeon or recommend other fun dungeons as well!

[h3]💚 Kickstarter - A big thank you![/h3]

If you haven't checked your [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/firechick/super-dungeon-maker-play-build-and-share-your-dungeon/posts/4078201]kickstarter[/url] page for SDM lately, it's worth a trip as we share some exclusive behind the scenes infos as well.

Happy creating!

notes.title: Bugfixes for Update 1.1!
notes.notes:
[h1]⭐ Fixed 1.1 Bugs - An Update! ⭐[/h1]

[b]Dear Super Dungeon Maker community! [/b]

first of all, we're sorry fixing the bugs took us a longer than expected. The timing of those bugs was quite unfortunate, but now we're ready to release the fix for the bugs that snuck into our major 1.1 update. 

**Creating and completing dungeons should now work as expected**, still we're keen on your experience and hope you wont find any of the bugs below!

[h2]🔥 What's been fixed?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Crystal Switches and Blocks (Red & Blue) would sometimes reset when walking into a new room when playing a dungeon.
[*] Triggers would not work correctly after walking too close to or through a big door.
[*] Feather dungeon was missing a door.
[*] Red-Slime would turn into green slime when stunning it using the hookshot.
[*] The Hall of Fame Area and some Dungeons where missing some tiles and objects.
[*] Reveton could be killed without bombs by stunning it first.
[/list]

Feedback is always welcome! We are looking forward to fix other bugs you submitted, but those were definitely the ones that cause the most headache. 

If you need friends to share your dungeons with, or just want to hang out with a great creative community, definitely check out our Discord server!

Happy creating!

notes.notes:
- Players could skip over large holes by timing the feather item correctly
- Players would sometimes incorrectly show a drowning or falling animation when using the feather item close to the edge of water or a hole
- Players could get stuck in an endless falling loop when falling into a hole that leads to another hole on the floor below
- Triggers would sometimes not work when entering a room
- Wall-Triggers would sometimes not affect any trigger channels

notes.title: Update 1.1: Final Kickstarter Rewards and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]⭐ Huge 1.1 Update! ⭐[/h1]

[b]Dear Super Dungeon Maker community! [/b]

We're excited to unveil the latest Update with all the Kickstarter Rewards in place - and MORE! The update is now available for everyone on [b]Steam [/b]and [b]Nintendo Switch.[/b] Dive in to see what we've got in store for you:

[h2]🔥 What's new?[/h2]
Added two new dungeon themes, each with one special unique floor tile.

[h3]Lava Theme - It's hot![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/c22728df5d886f4a6c2278d89ecb154f4437e0fd.gif[/img]
[i]What's special?[/i] Ice blocks have an additional function on the Lava theme, they transform 3 burning lava tiles into 3 walkable stone tiles! 

[h3]Tomb Theme - Skeletons beware![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/cdc2f796ac39849f2e73596a1b7cc3e67530af3a.gif[/img]
[i]What's special?[/i] Cobwebs are placed on holes, making them traversable without a feather or hook! 

[h3]New Enemies - Six times the fun![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/a9b2d959fe723da55d859af9c5c04548e89b16ac.gif[/img]
A bunch of new enemies, with new mechanics that will challenge you in a heated moment! You not only need to check your back, you'll also have your Hook, Bomb and Spin attack ready, if you want to surive the fight! 

[list]
[*] Reveton (Skeleton Chicken - Bomb him!)
[*] Projeggslime (Slime with projectiles - Attack straight on!)
[*] Sparkull (Fire Skull - They just bounce of walls?!)
[*] Hoohoo (Ghost Chicken - Spin attack!)
[*] Shieldforker (Forker with a shield - You need the Hook!)
[*] Homefly (Chasing Fly - It's chasing me!)
[/list]

[h3]New Features - Eggs, Corn, Blocks and Doors![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/e1b71cbc9c2cb818f502894b5d1d374201b2a3eb.gif[/img]
[i]What's special?[/i] The golden corn can be found throughout a dungeon. You can use them either as a form of collectible and side quest to the player, but also as a new way to block of paths or even create "vendors". The doors and blocks always use 10 corn to unlock, so place them wisely!

[list]
[*] Golden Eggs - [b]They are now placeble items! 🔥🔥 You can place multiple eggs as multiple endings on every level of the dungeon now. It's pretty epic! [/b]
[*] Gold Corn - Hide it in grass, chests or just place them on difficult to reach places!
[*] Cornblocks - Unlock a 1x1 block with 10 gold corn
[*] Corndoors - Unlock the door with 10 gold corn
[/list]

[h3]Pets - Some are Kickstarter exclusive![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/2301d9c512baab7d1ea16bb61606ca5f59661867.gif[/img]
As many of the new features, Pets were also a Kickstarter reward. You can get a pet bottom left in the town, but some pets are exclusive. They are cute and follow you around during your dungeon adventures!

[h2]A quick recap - Recent changes you might have missed![/h2]

[list]
[*] Steam Trading Cards (Steam Only): personalize your gaming profile.
[*] Added the "Hall of Fame" to the village hub
[i]You can play six dungeons created by our most dedicated Kickstarter supporters here[/i]
[*] Traps will now trigger hit and barrier switches. Use your creativity now to build some automated contraptions.
[*] Reworked the Undo-System to be more stable
[*] Replaced the fill bucket tool with a rectangle tool for tile mode
[*] We added a button that let's you instantly snap Fink towards the cursor when editing a dungeon.
[*] Builder palette no longer automatically collapses after a certain time.
[*] Added some little animations when placing objects or tiles.
[/list]

We truly hope this update is as fun for you as it is for us! Feedback is always welcome and if you need friends to share your dungeons with, or just want to hang out with a great creative community, definitely check out our Discord server!

notes.title: Fresh Adventures Await: Dive into Our Latest Update!
notes.notes:
Dear Super Dungeon Maker community,

We're excited to unveil a slew of fresh updates and enhancements for our game. The update is now available for everyone on [b]Steam [/b]and [b]Nintendo Switch.[/b] Dive in to see what we've got in store for you:

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
Added two new dungeon themes each with one unique floor tile

-[b]Hollywood or Bollywood?[/b]-
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/b28079afeb4a475312dbdd190c201a9366e2c7f9.jpg[/img]
[i]Filmset (Unique floor: A stage that will turn off all other lights and focus a spotlight on the player)[/i]

-[b]The aliens are among us[/b]-
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/f0c3a235dcd1691ac2ac8e9e5847bb037375b7ac.jpg[/img]
[i]"So Many Me" (Unique floor: A toxic mist that will deal damage when walking through or standing in it)[/i]

Added the "Hall of Fame" to the village hub
[i]You can play six dungeons created by our most dedicated Kickstarter supporters here[/i]
Replaced the fill bucket tool with a rectangle tool for tile mode
We added a button that let's you instantly snap Fink towards the cursor when editing a dungeon.

[h2]What's changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Traps will now trigger hit and barrier switches. Use your creativity now to build some automated contraptions.
[*] Reworked the Undo-System to be more stable and not result in broken rooms/objects all the time.
[*] Builder palette no longer automatically collapses after a certain time.
[*] Added automatic camera movement, when dragging an object towards the screens edge when using a gamepad.
[*] Improved Stair transition to make it less likely for players to accidentally walk back into stairs.
[*] Added some little animations when placing objects or tiles.
[*] Fixed an issue where users couldn't play online dungeons.
[/list]
[h2]Bug-Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sign in front of Fink's secret cave displayed a placeholder text.
[*] One of the birds had a placeholder text in it's speech bubble.
[*] Player Dungeons could not be correctly deleted.
[*] Player Dungeons would show up multiple times.
[*] Online Dungeons would sometimes load an empty dungeon.
[*] Room outlines would sometimes break.
[*] Massively improved the performance for dungeons with many rooms.
[*] In some cases restarting the dungeon would instead load a completely empty dungeon.
[*] Golden Egg is now visible on the map again.
[*] Collecting the flipper item multiple times would add it to the UI multiple times.
[*] Description text in the online dungeon report form could overflow the input field.
[*] Speechbubbles would stay active when switching to build mode.
[*] Game would crash when trying to show the tooltip of one of the floors in the mystic garden theme.
[/list]
[h3]Onward to 400 Reviews - We're Already at 320!🚀[/h3]
Indeed, thanks to all of you, we've already reached 320 reviews on Steam. This significant progress marks our journey towards the next big milestone: 400 reviews. While we haven't achieved our ultimate goal yet, let's take a moment to celebrate how far we've come. 🎉🥳🎈

Remember, every piece of feedback helps us to improve and grow, so thank you again for taking the time to leave a review!

notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 🙌

We have another update for you today along with some news about what Julian and Linda are working on. For now, here is the changelog:

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
-Added support for Steam Cloud Saves☁️💾

[h3]What's changed?[/h3]
-Added small animations when placing objects or tiles. 
-The map now differentiates between rooms you have visited and those you have not.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/ced87f8730b339224fc2d97e38d447c201a87c33.png[/img]

[h3]Bug-Fixes[/h3]
-The large treasure chest could not be placed when an item was next to it on the right side.
-A placeholder text appeared in one of the speech bubbles on the overworld screen.

[h3]Character and Pet Developments🎨🐾[/h3]
Linda is currently working on the initial drafts for a new character that will be added to the game. We're considering different animal characters as well [b]as a human character.[/b] Once we're satisfied, we'll move the drafts into the fine-tuning phase. We're planning to hold a vote on this soon.

Julian is in the process of integrating the Pet system. This will allow you to bring a mythical creature of your choice along with you on your adventure. We have a wide variety of pets and we believe there's something for everyone.

[h3]Getting Closer to 300 Reviews🎯[/h3]
We're only 14 reviews away from the incredible mark of 300 reviews on Steam. So, take a moment to leave us your opinion and a review. We appreciate all feedback.

Once again, thank you for your support and trust. Let's do this, dear community!💪💖

notes.title: Release Day reveal!
notes.notes:
Hey Finkunity, 
The time has finally come, and a few of you have already heard about it over Easter. There is an official release date for Super Dungeon Maker on Nintendo Switch and PC! Let´s party and celebrate this incredible event and milestone💚

[h3][b]🎉May 3rd 2023🎉[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=iFTY0YEaTvc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]We know you have a lot of questions and I´ll try to answer the most important directly for you![/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Where can I wishlist SDM for Nintendo Switch? [/b][/h3]
Just press the button!
[url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/super-dungeon-maker-switch/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/e85a38a1140f3dbc84f8c9826e3de15b8864f811.png[/img]
[/url]

[h3][b]Will there be more content after the 1.0 Release? [/b][/h3]
Yes, it will. We even have a few things already prepared that won't make it into the game before release, remember that only one person can sit at the coding desk and it naturally takes a little longer to implement things. It is also important that we can't promise you now what will happen in 6 months. Our journey from release is dependent on whether or not we are successful with Super Dungeon Maker. 

[h3][b]Why were the bug fixes in focus and not new content?[/b][/h3]
Also for this point, only one person can code, so the focus remains on the bugs, for now, to deliver Super Dungeon Maker as cleanly and polished as possible and not to have missed serious stopper bugs afterward. 

[h3][b]What happens to the Kickstarter Rewards?[/b][/h3]
We are already working on the rewards in the background. However, most of these will make their way into the game after the release. Of course, these rewards will be coming 100%, after all, we want to keep our Kickstarter promises and not disappoint you. 

[h3][b]Feedback[/b][/h3]
For those of you who are new to the Super Dungeon Maker family, we always appreciate feedback and reviews, so we know what's already good and where we can improve!

notes.title: Weekly Update 005
notes.notes:
Hi awesome Community!
It´s Monday and time for our weekly changelog!

[previewyoutube=R-WAs4vQy6c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]What's new[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Undo/Redo System - In Build-Mode you can now Undo your last actions with the simple press of a button!!! - Made a mistake? No Problem, simply press the Undo Key! If only this was available in real life
[/list]

[b][h3]What's changed[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] We moved the camera control UI to the Top-Left
[*] We moved the zoom icons to the bottom of the screen and changed the gamepad inputs to Left Stick/Right Stick Press - LB/RB are now used for Undo/Redo
[/list]

[b][h3]Known issues
[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] When using Undo after placing a door, the door will be undone, but any changes to the floor/walls made by the door will not be undone.
[/list]

Your team @rokaplay and FIRECHICK
